scope: Norms, domains, quantifiers, units and limit requirements are explicit. This file is an interface ledger, not a Lean proof receipt.

implementedFiniteModel.space: H = C^(n+1), 1 <= n <= 32, Euclidean norm ||v||_2^2 = sum_j |v_j|^2
implementedFiniteModel.operator: H = diag(0, Delta+epsilon_1, ..., Delta+epsilon_n), Delta>0 and epsilon_j>=0
implementedFiniteModel.domain: D(H) = H (finite dimension); the full vacuum subspace is span(e_0)
implementedFiniteModel.semigroup: T_t = exp(-t H/hbar), all real t>=0; hbar has dimensions energy*time
implementedFiniteModel.channel: v=(0,sqrt(w_1),...,sqrt(w_n)), w_j>=0, sum_j w_j>0; C(t)=<v,T_t v>
implementedFiniteModel.quantifiers: For every permitted explicit finite list, every real t>=0, C(t)=sum_j w_j exp(-(Delta+epsilon_j)t/hbar) and 0<=C(t)<=||v||_2^2 exp(-Delta t/hbar).
implementedFiniteModel.implementation: family.mjs finiteSpectralModel constructs the displayed finite energies and evaluates finite sums using Float64; no infinite-sum exchange or measured ensemble is used.
implementedFiniteModel.leanScope: Conditional.lean proves a separate exact natural-number finite support lower bound and interval exclusion; it does not prove this full real exponential estimate.

infiniteDimensionalContract.space: A specified complex Hilbert space (H,<.,.>,||.||), not an unspecified function space
infiniteDimensionalContract.hamiltonian: A densely defined self-adjoint nonnegative operator H:D(H)->H; P0 is the orthogonal projection onto the full ker(H), not automatically one chosen vacuum vector
infiniteDimensionalContract.gap: Delta>0 and sigma(H) subset {0} union [Delta,infinity); existence of such H is not obtained from a 4D classical connection
infiniteDimensionalContract.vectorNormBound: For every v in ran(I-P0), 0<=<v,exp(-tH/hbar)v><=||v||^2 exp(-Delta*t/hbar)
infiniteDimensionalContract.boundedObservable: If O is bounded and Omega is normalized vacuum, set v=(I-P0)O Omega. Then the finite positive spectral measure mu_v has total mass ||v||^2.
infiniteDimensionalContract.unboundedObservable: Specify Omega in D(O), O Omega in H, a common invariant domain where required, and finite vector norm. Bounded-operator estimates cannot be silently applied.
infiniteDimensionalContract.spectralMeasure: C(t)=integral exp(-E*t/hbar) dmu_v(E), with finite positive mu_v supported on [Delta,infinity). Laplace-transform domination uses this positivity and support.
infiniteDimensionalContract.sumAndLimitExchange: For an infinite expansion require a positive measure/Tonelli condition or an explicit integrable dominating function and the stated convergence mode. A visually convergent finite sum is insufficient.
infiniteDimensionalContract.gapInference: Decay in one chosen channel only yields its supported excitation scale under the stated spectral assumptions. To certify the global gap from correlators needs suitable cyclicity/density or completeness/overlap control across channels.
infiniteDimensionalContract.reconstruction: A continuum quantum Yang-Mills measure, reflection positivity, regularity, Euclidean covariance and reconstruction hypotheses are separate construction tasks. None are asserted by this module.

classicalStateFamily.ASSUMED_BOUND: Delta changes a HYPOTHESIS record and assumption hash; the actual classical field and its physical hash remain fixed.
classicalStateFamily.UNITS: Lunit=Delta/referenceDelta in base length units; x_display=x/Lunit, A_display=Lunit A, F_display=Lunit^2 F, q4_display=Lunit^4 q4, q3_display=Lunit^3 q3. The physical source is unchanged.
classicalStateFamily.CLASSICAL_SCALE: lambda=Delta/referenceDelta; A_lambda(x)=lambda A(c+lambda(x-c)), rho and every trial-function length scale by 1/lambda. Fourier torus periods also scale. This is an actual source change, not a spectral theorem.
classicalStateFamily.EFFECTIVE_MODEL: ell=hbarC/Delta, rho=kappa ell; A_trial=(epsilon/ell) sum c phi((x-c)/ell) T. The complete coefficient array, seed, coupling and boundary are persisted. The relation is a DEFINITION of the effective model.
classicalStateFamily.ENSEMBLE_ESTIMATE: NOT_IMPLEMENTED. A statistical estimate would need ensembles at specified coupling, spacing, volume, boundary, autocorrelation/error analysis, overlap channels and independent continuum/infinite-volume extrapolations.

projectionContract.slice: S_c(x1,x2,x3)=(x1,x2,x3,c); a scalar density is pulled back. Reconstructing a known slice uses explicit c and on-slice membership.
projectionContract.linearProjection: P:R4->R3 is the actual input rank-three matrix. Every source sample is retained. Points differ by ker(P), so coincident screen positions are not equality of 4D states.
projectionContract.scalarMarginal: Integrating a gauge-invariant scalar along x4 returns a scalar of dimension length^-3. It does not return a 3D gauge connection or preserve a Hamiltonian spectrum.
projectionContract.propertyTransfer: A property descends only with an explicit certificate of invariance on full fibres, or an explicit reconstruction/injectivity hypothesis on a restricted domain.
projectionContract.leanScope: project_slice_roundtrip, projection_collision, property_descends_with_fibre_certificate, reconstruction_on_selected_slice are actually kernel checked.
